title: Opener
body:
## Opener

**“Hi {first_name}, this is {rep_first_name} with {company}. I’m calling about {address}. Do you have a minute?”**

> Example script. Replace it with your own team’s opener.

title: Rapport
body:
## Rapport

Ask one open question about them before you ask about the property.

**“How long have you been at {address}?”**

title: Qualifying
body:
## Qualifying

- Are you the owner, or is anyone else on the title?
- Is anyone living there right now?

title: Motivation
body:
## Motivation

**“What has you thinking about selling?”**

Let them talk. Follow up on what they say.

title: Condition
body:
## Condition

- How old is the roof?
- Any work the house needs that you know about?

title: Timeline
body:
## Timeline

**“If everything lined up, when would you want to be done?”**

title: Price
body:
## Price

**“Do you have a number in mind for the property?”**

title: Close
body:
## Close

Summarize what you heard, state the next step, and set a time for it.

**“Can we pick a time tomorrow to go over the numbers?”**

title: Voicemail
body:
## Voicemail

“Hi {first_name}, this is {rep_first_name} with {company} about {address}. Call me back at {phone}. Thanks.”

title: Not interested
body: **“Understood. Is that true for any price, or just not right now?”**

title: Call me back later
body: **“Sure. What day and time works best for you?”**

title: Need to talk to my spouse
body: **“That makes sense. When could the three of us talk together?”**
